technique_name: Describe the basic operation of a database
description: A database is a structured collection of data stored on a computer system. A database can be used to store information such as a person's name, address, birthday, and any other pertinent information. To store this data, the database first breaks down the information into individual pieces (called fields) and then arranges these fields together as records.
